message:
The other day, we found ourselves diving into a fun little project: creating our own family emergency plans. Instead of the usual digital documents, we grabbed a stack of colorful paper and some markers, and we got to work. 🎨 It turned into a great bonding experience, as we not only mapped out our go-bags and emergency contacts but also reminisced about past family adventures. 

Rediscovering low-tech fun made it feel less like a chore and more like a family art day! Plus, it was a comforting reminder that preparedness doesn't have to be all about gadgets and apps; sometimes, it’s just about coming together as a family. How do you make your preparedness planning more enjoyable?
